Sirona Technologies provides permanent carbon removal through scalable Direct Air Capture technology, offering certified high-quality carbon credits to help companies meet their climate goals.
data.pricing: Sirona Technologies offers carbon removal credits at $0.80 per kilogram or $800 per tonne for individuals and small businesses through their self-serve platform. They also sell pre-packaged carbon offsets for specific activities, ranging from $1.60 for a hamburger (2kg CO2) to $376 for a Europe-NYC flight (470kg CO2). Enterprise customers can inquire for custom pricing and volumes through their contact form.
